dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you missing your big brother?
Yeah! I mean, I miss my two oldest brothers too, but they come home every few days, so it's not the same...
But big brother Ajax, he's different and I miss him so much more! He's the best toy salesman ever, and he always brings back tons of new toys whenever he comes home!
Even when he can't make it home, he still writes letters to Tonia... and he always sends lots of yummy treats and fun things with them.
The treats and toys are great and all, but... it's still way better when big brother comes home to play with me...
